name: Japan
dossier:
The Japan national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Samurai Blue, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 18 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Technical, brave and forever knocking on the quarter-final door.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Japan will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group F and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group F. The connection between Takefusa Kubo and Kaoru Mitoma is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Takefusa Kubo - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Japan are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Japan beat both Germany AND Spain in the 2022 group stage  -  then exited on penalties, breaking hearts.
Japan boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Round of 16 (multiple).
